data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order (converter, holidays, mail with the right subject and body format), but it hardcodes the recipient as a parameter instead of ops@example.com, ends with "Save or send the draft" where the true workflow says never send and click Discard, and navigates holidays through Calendar instead of the Holidays menu. A builder could mostly automate it, but the send/save ending is wrong and risky, and the Calendar path is questionable.
